calculate_psnr: calculate the PSNR metric between two images with optional border cropping for quality assessment
calculate_ssim: calculate the SSIM metric between two images for structural similarity comparison and quality evaluation
imresize_np: resize a numpy image array using bicubic interpolation with optional antialiasing for downsampling
augment_img: augment a numpy image by applying one of eight flip and rotation transformations for data augmentation
rgb2ycbcr: convert an RGB image to YCbCr color space with option to return only the luminance Y channel
